scope: All remaining exercises; user requests continuous work until every exercise is connected.

recipe.criteria: Lie supine, cross one ankle above the opposite knee and flex the crossed foot. Hold behind the uncrossed thigh and gently draw it toward chest, keeping head and pelvis supported.
Full boat balance on seated pelvis, long reclining torso, straight legs raised about 45 degrees, arms extended parallel to floor with palms inward.
Seated butterfly hold, knees relaxed outward and soles together, hands supporting feet, long spine with gentle forward inclination.

entries.name: 싱글 암 케이블 리어 델트 플라이

recipe.criteria: Sit upright, support one shoulder lightly with opposite hand, side bend head away from supported shoulder without rotating torso. Hold gently with feet flat and pelvis supported.
Lie supine with opposite leg straight, support the raised thigh with both hands, extend raised knee toward ceiling and hold gentle hamstring stretch with head and torso relaxed.
Supine happy baby hold: knees wider than torso toward armpits, shins vertical, soles face ceiling, hands on outside edges of feet, relaxed supported head and back.
Gentle seated forward fold with long spine, parallel straight legs, flexed toes up and palms on floor beside legs; low folded blanket under pelvis.
Prone quadriceps hold: one knee flexed and ankle held with matching hand, thighs aligned, opposite leg extended and torso supported.
Supine cross-body glute/piriformis stretch: keep opposite leg straight, bring bent knee toward opposite shoulder while supporting outside knee and ankle with hands; head and back remain supported.
Sit upright on stool, band above knees, feet flat. Open both knees against band without moving pelvis, then return slowly. 3.5 seconds open, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds close.
Lie supine with both knees initially bent, keep one foot grounded and draw the other knee toward chest, supporting behind the thigh with both hands. Keep head and back supported and hold gently.
Supine double knee to chest hold, both thighs supported with relaxed head and back; knees flexed symmetrically.
Supine cross-body glute/piriformis stretch: keep opposite leg straight, bring bent knee toward opposite shoulder while supporting outside knee and ankle with hands; head and back remain supported.
Gentle seated straddle forward lean, legs wide and straight with toes up, spine long, hands on floor in front for support.
